:::{#def-prediction-rule}
#### Prediction rule

The **prediction rule** $\fitted$
is shorthand for the [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\fitmodf{\trainset}$
that a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$
produces from the [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$,
written without the subscript when the training set is the one in use:

$$
\fitted \eqdef \fitmodf{\trainset}.
$$ {#eq-prediction-rule}

:::
